01 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE WORK

Turning technical ideas into working systems

I'm a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) student at the University of Lucknow with a 9.04/10 CGPA. My work spans Java, data structures and algorithms, computer vision, geospatial AI and backend development.

I like building things that run in real time and solve a concrete problem, from a webcam-driven gesture interface to satellite-based crop intelligence built for the ISRO Bharatiya Antariksh Hackathon 2026.

Away from projects, I practise algorithmic problem solving, teach DSA and Java concepts to my peers, and write about AI, computer vision, Java and DSA for developers.

02 / SELECTED PROJECTS

Selected projects

Six projects and concepts across AI, computer vision and software. Explore the problem, contribution and technical approach.

Submitted · Hackathon 2026/01

Pheno-Crop-Analytics

An AI-powered crop monitoring and geospatial decision-support platform for Varanasi, built by Team Orbit Eye. It classifies crops, spots water stress and advises on irrigation.

My contribution: Engineered the 29-band feature stack, classification pipeline and dashboard modules with Team Orbit Eye.

  • Google Earth Engine
  • Sentinel-1 and 2
  • Random Forest
  • GIS
  • JavaScript
Explore case study

Problem

How can multi-source satellite data support crop and irrigation decisions?

Technical approach

  • Combines Sentinel-1/2, CHIRPS rainfall, ERA5 temperature, DEM and land-cover data into a 29-band feature stack.
  • Random Forest classification across 8 crop and fallow classes.
  • Dashboard modules for crop health, moisture and water stress, irrigation advisory, yield potential, disease risk, hotspots and priority mapping.

Engineering challenge

Combining radar, optical and environmental inputs into one feature stack.

Outcome

Submitted · Hackathon 2026. No measured benchmark is supplied.

Framework · Design/02

PRATIRUP

A predictive digital-twin framework for aero piston engines used in MALE UAVs, focused on health monitoring and predictive maintenance.

My contribution: Designed the predictive framework and structured risk and anomaly indicators.

  • AI/ML
  • Predictive analytics
  • Digital twin
Explore case study

Problem

How can engine telemetry support propulsion-health decisions?

Technical approach

  • Telemetry-driven health monitoring and reliability analytics.
  • Real-time risk and anomaly indicators with decision-support components for propulsion reliability.

Engineering challenge

Structuring telemetry and risk indicators into usable decision support.

Outcome

Framework · Design. No measured benchmark is supplied.

Concept · Pipeline design/03

SignBridgeAI

A two-way assistive communication concept connecting sign-language users and hearing users through real-time gesture recognition and speech-to-text.

My contribution: Designed the multimodal communication concept and AI pipeline.

  • MediaPipe
  • CNN and LSTM
  • Speech-to-text
  • Unity
Explore case study

Problem

How can sign-language and hearing users communicate in both directions?

Technical approach

  • Pipeline chains hand-pose estimation, deep-learning sign classification and speech transcription.
  • Outputs visual signs or an avatar so the conversation works in both directions.

Engineering challenge

Connecting gesture classification, speech transcription and visual output.

Outcome

Concept · Pipeline design. No measured benchmark is supplied.

Built · Webcam interface/04

Hand Gesture Control System

A webcam interface that tracks your hand and maps gestures to cursor movement, including an air-click.

My contribution: Built the tracking interface, gesture mapping, filtering and smoothing.

  • Java
  • OpenCV
  • Computer vision
Explore case study

Problem

How can a webcam enable touch-free cursor interaction?

Technical approach

  • Contour detection with gesture-to-cursor mapping and Air Click interaction.
  • Noise filtering and motion smoothing keep control stable and low-latency across changing backgrounds and lighting.

Engineering challenge

Stabilising hand tracking across changing lighting and backgrounds.

Outcome

Built · Webcam interface. No measured benchmark is supplied.

Built · Database integration/05

Facial Recognition Attendance System

Automated attendance that recognises faces on camera and logs each person with a timestamp in a MySQL database.

My contribution: Built the recognition, registration and database-backed logging workflow.

  • Java
  • OpenCV
  • LBPH
  • JDBC
  • MySQL
Explore case study

Problem

How can face recognition reduce manual attendance logging?

Technical approach

  • Haar Cascade detection with LBPH recognition, plus a registration flow for new faces.
  • Confidence filtering and duplicate prevention protect the attendance record.
  • MySQL integration through JDBC with timestamped logging.

Engineering challenge

Filtering recognition confidence and preventing duplicate records.

Outcome

Built · Database integration. No measured benchmark is supplied.

Built · File-based system/06

Inventory Management System

A persistent, file-based inventory tool that tracks stock in and out and warns when items run low.

My contribution: Implemented file-based CRUD, stock operations and inventory checks.

  • C
  • Structs
  • File handling
  • CRUD
Explore case study

Problem

How can a simple tool keep stock records persistent and consistent?

Technical approach

  • Stock-in and stock-out with duplicate prevention.
  • Low-stock alerts and inventory valuation.
  • Data stored between runs using structs with fread and fwrite.

Engineering challenge

Maintaining persistent records and preventing duplicate stock entries.

Outcome

Built · File-based system. No measured benchmark is supplied.
